Name: L_Hip,L_Knee,L_Ankle,L_Ball
Description: Create a Quadruped Leg (v002: matrix nodes instead of constraints, no follicles, parallel evaluation, bendy curve, leg / controllers scale, Foot v002 ready)

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Create a Quadruped Leg.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- Mirror: choose one option (for example: True, False, Right_Only).
- DogMode: choose one option (for example: Back, Front).
- ForcePoleVectorDistance: choose one option (Off, Leg_Distance, Half_Leg_Distance, Third_Leg_Distance, Double_Leg_Distance, Positive_1_5). Off = default pole vector distance; Leg/Half/Third/Double force the pole vector locator to a distance based on the leg's own length, direction auto-flipped by DogMode (Front = Z+, Back = Z-) to keep the IK pole vector stable; Positive_1_5 forces a fixed Z+1.5 regardless of DogMode.
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- TwistAmount: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- CreateRibbons: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. With ribbons the limb attrs get the BendyCurve attrs (like Limb v002): BendyCurve 0 straight lines through the knee / ankle mid bendy controllers, 10 arcs; AutoCurve adds curve the more the knee / ankle bend; Upper/Mid/LowerCurve per segment (negative bows the other way); HipEase / BallEase keep the leg leaving the hip / ball straight. Proxied on the mid bendy controllers.
- BendyCurve (needs CreateRibbons): ON builds the Limb v002 bendy path with the curve attrs above. OFF keeps the same bendy controllers (straight lines through the mid bendy controllers, Start / End bendy moves, handles) with far less nodes, no curve attrs, faster playback.
- SoftIk: adds the SoftIk attr (0-10) to the leg attrs, the hip -> ankle IK eases to straight instead of popping at full reach (10 = soft zone of 20% of the hip -> ankle length). With Stretch_On the stretch takes over past full length. Off by default.
- Leg scale: every leg gets a GlobalScale controller (L_BkLeg_GlobalScale_Ctrl / L_FrLeg_GlobalScale_Ctrl) that scales the whole leg from the hip, the Foot v002 block scales the foot with it.
- Controllers scale: FK, Top IK and Bendy controllers scale the bind joints around them (uniform or non uniform). FK is a normal hierarchy (the FK hip scale makes the leg longer). The ball controllers (IK, SubIk, FK ball) do not scale the leg, they scale the ball joint (L_BkBall_Jnt), the Foot v002 foot follows it.
- Use the Foot v002 block for the feet (Foot v001 keeps working, without the foot scale).
- Template parent examples: L_Hand_Ankle_Jnt, L_Foot_Ankle_Jnt, L_FrAnkle_Jnt.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
